atoms.html: Because I really wanted the particles to have more variation, Riley shared this wrangle with me. It calculates the distance between each particle and the camera, then uses that distance together with some random variation to control the particle pscale (size). This helps the particles maintain a more consistent screen size while adding natural size variation, so they look more balanced and visually natural in the scene.
